description: Find notable people on Wikidata by name or by occupation, nationality, gender and birth/death year filters. No login or API key required.

birthYearMax.description: Latest birth year to include. Leave empty for no upper bound.
birthYearMax.title: Birth year to

birthYearMin.description: Earliest birth year to include. Leave empty for no lower bound.
birthYearMin.title: Birth year from

deathYearMax.description: Latest death year to include. Leave empty for no upper bound.
deathYearMax.title: Death year to

deathYearMin.description: Earliest death year to include. Leave empty for no lower bound.
deathYearMin.title: Death year from

deceasedOnly.description: Only return people with a recorded date of death.
deceasedOnly.title: Deceased only

entityId.description: One or more Wikidata QIDs or entity URLs for Look up IDs mode, separated by commas or spaces, for example Q937, Q7186.
entityId.title: Wikidata IDs

firstName.description: First name used when Full name is empty.
firstName.title: First name

gender.description: Restrict results to a recorded gender.
gender.title: Gender

language.description: Language for names, descriptions and resolved labels. Falls back to English when missing.
language.sectionDescription: Choose how many records to return and how their labels are written.
language.title: Label language

lastName.description: Last name used when Full name is empty.
lastName.title: Last name

maxItems.description: Maximum number of people to return (1-1000).
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Search a person by name, browse all people matching filters, or fetch specific Wikidata entity IDs.
mode.sectionDescription: Choose how to find people, then fill the field for that mode.
mode.title: Mode

nationality.description: Country of citizenship QID or name, for example Q183 or Germany.
nationality.title: Nationality

occupation.description: Occupation QID or name, for example Q169470 or physicist.
occupation.sectionDescription: Optional filters. They apply to Search and Browse modes and are combined with AND.
occupation.title: Occupation

searchQuery.description: Full name to search for (overrides first and last name), for example "Marie Curie". Leave empty when using Browse or Look up IDs.
searchQuery.title: Full name

title: Wikidata Notable People Input
